title: Literature-to-proof transfer
task: Read primary anti-concentration and quadratic-form density theorems, match every hypothesis, and apply a source-valid result to close a concrete implication. If an exact prior solution is found, report it without claiming novelty or changing target unilaterally.
acceptance: A proved target-level implication, explicit rigorous counterexample, or quantitatively stated supporting lemma whose remaining connection to the full target is explicit.
